# Evidence Policy Checklist: Spec Archive and Evidence Retention

**Purpose**: Validate SPEC-002A evidence-policy requirements before task generation, with focus on Argos/CI provenance, screenshot retention boundaries, negative guard coverage, PR readiness, and SPEC-002 metadata-gate precedent.
**Created**: 2026-04-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` workflow based on SPEC-002A source artifacts, SPEC-002 Argos evidence precedent, Mission Control constitution requirements, and Argos documentation for Playwright, Storybook, screenshot metadata, GitHub integration, baseline builds, subset builds, and Tests dashboard evidence.

## Provenance-First Evidence Model

- [x] CHK001 Does the specification make Argos/CI provenance the source of truth for UI evidence retention instead of committed generated screenshots? [Consistency, Spec FR-004, FR-014]
- [x] CHK002 Does the specification require PR URL, merge commit or tree reference, CI run URL, Argos build/review URL, command provenance, and recovery commands in durable archive evidence? [Completeness, Spec FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 Does the evidence model distinguish generated screenshots as review artifacts rather than default source-controlled archival payloads? [Clarity, Spec FR-004, FR-014, Constitution Principle XIV]
- [x] CHK004 Does the specification require Argos and CI metadata gate outcomes, including SPEC-002-style Argos metadata validation results, to be recorded as part of evidence provenance? [Gap resolved, Spec FR-004, SC-002]
- [x] CHK005 Does the specification define optional artifact manifests as link/hash metadata for screenshots or binary outputs without making generated screenshots committed source files by default? [Gap resolved, Spec FR-004, SC-002, Data Model §EvidenceProvenance]

## Screenshot Retention Boundary

- [x] CHK006 Does the archive policy allow committed screenshot retention only as an explicit exception rather than the default archival path? [Completeness, Roadmap P1A-AC6, Spec FR-004]
- [x] CHK007 Does the data model state that screenshots may be referenced but are not required as committed source files? [Consistency, Data Model §EvidenceProvenance]
- [x] CHK008 Does the quickstart require validating that no generated screenshots must exist in source control for provenance to be complete? [Coverage, Quickstart §Dry-Run Archive Validation]
- [x] CHK009 Does the archive contract reject or flag committed generated screenshots as default archival payload? [Consistency, Contract §Archive Sweep Command Contract]
- [x] CHK010 Does the specification require a concrete local/CI guard or negative fixture/test that fails or flags accidentally committed generated screenshots and names the offending path? [Gap resolved, Spec FR-016, SC-007]

## Visual Review and PR Readiness

- [x] CHK011 Does the policy preserve the Real UI Journey Quality Gate instead of weakening visual review obligations? [Consistency, Constitution Principle XIV]
- [x] CHK012 Does SPEC-002 precedent require reviewing Argos Storybook builds, Argos Playwright builds, GitHub Actions artifacts, and screenshots before updating the PR branch? [Traceability, SPEC-002 quickstart]
- [x] CHK013 Does SPEC-002 precedent treat an empty Argos Tests tab after accepted main reference builds as a release-blocking observability defect? [Traceability, SPEC-002 quickstart and retrospective]
- [x] CHK014 Does SPEC-002A itself state that missing evidence, failing metadata gates, visible UI defects, clipped/overlapping controls, wrong data, inaccessible controls, or broken journeys still block PR readiness even though screenshots are not committed by default? [Gap resolved, Spec FR-018, Quickstart §PR Readiness Evidence Gate]

## SPEC-002 Argos Alignment

- [x] CHK015 Does the policy preserve Docker-backed Playwright journey evidence in Argos rather than relying only on Storybook component screenshots? [Consistency, SPEC-002 quickstart]
- [x] CHK016 Does the policy preserve Storybook + Argos visual coverage as component/shell evidence without replacing real Playwright journey coverage? [Consistency, SPEC-002 retrospective]
- [x] CHK017 Does the evidence policy align with Argos metadata fields for test identity, source location, tags, viewport, browser, automation library, and SDK? [Completeness, Argos screenshot metadata docs]
- [x] CHK018 Does SPEC-002A explicitly carry forward SPEC-002 no-empty-build behavior so non-visual or flag-off regression runs do not upload empty Argos builds? [Gap resolved, Spec FR-019]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK019 Can SC-002 be objectively evaluated without requiring generated screenshot files to be committed? [Measurability, Spec SC-002]
- [x] CHK020 Does SC-003 preserve Archive Sweep evidence fields without implying screenshot deletion or committed screenshot retention? [Consistency, Spec SC-003]
- [x] CHK021 Do acceptance criteria and quickstart steps preserve local and CI evidence paths rather than a CI-only policy? [Coverage, Roadmap P1A-AC4, P1A-AC5]
- [x] CHK022 Does the checklist domain avoid implementation verification and focus on requirements completeness, clarity, consistency, coverage, and measurability? [Checklist Quality]

## Notes

- Initial run status: five evidence-policy requirement-writing gaps found in CHK004, CHK005, CHK010, CHK014, and CHK018.
- Research sources: Argos Playwright docs state CI uploads avoid committing screenshots; Argos screenshot metadata docs define companion metadata fields and SDK-generated upload metadata; Argos GitHub integration docs define PR checks/comments and build links; Argos baseline/subset docs support non-empty baseline behavior; SPEC-002 quickstart and retrospective define the local no-empty-build and metadata-gate precedent.

## Remediation Re-run

- [x] CHK023 Was the metadata-gate outcome gap resolved by adding metadata gate outcomes to FR-004, SC-002, `ArchiveReport`, `EvidenceProvenance`, quickstart dry-run outputs, and the Archive Sweep contract? [Resolved, Spec FR-004, SC-002; Data Model §ArchiveReport; Contract §Archive Sweep Command Contract]
- [x] CHK024 Was the optional artifact-manifest gap resolved by requiring manifest names, hashes, CI artifact references, and retention classification without making generated screenshots committed source files by default? [Resolved, Spec FR-004; Data Model §EvidenceProvenance; Quickstart §Dry-Run Archive Validation]
- [x] CHK025 Was the screenshot guard gap resolved by requiring a local and CI guard, negative fixture, or documented equivalent that fails or flags unmanifested or oversized generated screenshot commits and names the offending path? [Resolved, Spec FR-016, SC-007; Quickstart §Screenshot Guard Validation]
- [x] CHK026 Was the PR-readiness gap resolved by stating that missing evidence, failing metadata gates, and known visible UI journey defects block readiness? [Resolved, Spec FR-018; Plan §Constitution Check; Quickstart §PR Readiness Evidence Gate]
- [x] CHK027 Was the SPEC-002 no-empty-build alignment gap resolved by carrying forward metadata-gate and no-empty-build behavior for future UI evidence runs? [Resolved, Spec FR-019; Contract §Archive Sweep Command Contract]
